scope: Actual unchanged protocol functions compiled and run on Apple Silicon with substituted GPIO fixtures. No physical TMP102, calibrated I2C timing, ESP32 backend execution or temperature observation is established. Truncated fixture streams return high and record exhaustion; physical SDA disconnection cannot in general be distinguished from a legitimate all-high sample without additional protocol/device checks.
